body: I think this is expected (as long as the error is output in console with a non-slient `logLevel`. The user is expected to restart the server via `r` key in CLI or edit the config to fix the problem.

Hmm, the `r` key isn't there for this case though. Vite's cli exits with `process.exit(1)` when the first start fails, and the shortcuts only get bound once a server exists.

Editing the config does recover it through the js api, I tried it. But createServer() already rejected, so the caller has no reference to the server that comes up afterwards. It ends up listening on a port with nothing able t

Ah, that makes sense. Then, I think we should close the watcher for errors in `configureServer`.

For `buildStart`, I think we should keep the behavior so it aligns with the non-client environments and bundled-dev mode.
https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/90bc034a97e7eccd0f3cbc69904fffa625a4c34d/packages/vite/src/node/server/index.ts#L1122-L1127

I did NOT know you could link code snippets. Wow.

Also yea nice ok. I can PR the `configureServer` change.

For `buildStart`, I should have mentioned that my repro only uses `middlewareMode: true`, and as it turns out that's important lol. W/o middleware mode `buildStart` runs in `listen` so `createServer` has alrdy returned the server and the caller can close it. That case is fine then I think.
Yeah, I think closing in middleware mode makes sense. In the future, I hope we can fix the inconsistency once we remove this special behavior of unbundled client environment.

Hi @materwelonDhruv, are you still planning to open the PR for this? You and @sapphi-red scoped it on Nov 2: close the watcher when `configureServer` throws, and also when `buildStart` throws in middleware mode. I don't see a PR yet, so I wanted to check before touching it. Happy to leave it with you if you're still on it; if you're not able to get to it, I'd like to pick it up.
Hey @0xABCD01 yep. I'm still working on this. It's my first time contributing to Vite, so I'm taking some time to understand stuff. I'll open the PR in a day or two.
